title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30338: expose internal put-away line event
summary: Report 7305 exposes a new event that allows extensions to receive and adjust the internal put-away line record after the dataitem filters are prepared.
key_points: New event OnAfterWhseInternalPutAwayLineOnPreDataItem provides access to the internal put-away line record
Event fires at the end of the dataitem's OnPreDataItem trigger
Enables extensions to modify the actual source record during put-away line creation
Addresses limitation where previous event used warehouse worksheet line instead
